name: Expanded Breath Weapon [Breath]
body:
Tapping into your inner dragon, you learn how to better harness your elemental power.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic breath weapon racial trait, character level 3rd.

Benefit: You can increase the area of your breath weapon to a 30 foot cone or 60 foot line.
